author: BrewSparrow
change_scope: Version/UI/ready-notification/banner labels and release packaging; startup observer and resident renderer/input module retained from test 6.

known_issues.description: RunClock absent from PS5 built-in gameplay recordings.
Capture controls reported unresponsive with panel open; current input filters suppress buttons.
Raw game-input route does not map Triangle; use Delete attempt / Confirm delete menu controls.
Test-6 baseline passed five consecutive alternating restart/shutdown launches. Its observer and resident module are retained; exact beta-3 ELF retest and broader compatibility remain pending.
Held/skipped/chattering chord handling and pending-scene/focus corrections retained. Startup test report does not separately certify every in-game input route.

automated_scope_excludes: actual PS5 injection and ShellUI composition
native_memory_regression: Old code fails neighbor-protection check; correction passes, including isolation/protection error paths.
native_sdk_regression: Real validator and early failure wrapper passed; transformed SDK initializer passed. The actual bridge compiled with resident target/options fails with the old prologue and passes with the naked correction. Linked and embedded bridge instruction guards passed.
startup_rejection_regression: Real graph/job tests issue one native start after clean or retained rejection; no automatic reinjection. Resident main is non-returning, and removed optional hook modules are absent from the linked renderer.
protection_diagnostics_regression: Native isolation failure, SDK sealing failure and mismatched observed protection produce distinct checked trace stages/results.

startup_diagnostic.scope: first signal through preparation, before publication

startup_observer_regression: Production observer lifecycle tests and the actual x86 checkpoint passed: disarm-before-detach, faults, unknown traps, timeout races and retained detach signal.
host_test_limitation: Host operations are substituted and do not emulate PS5 ptrace/Mono behavior. The complete beta-3 suite passed; an earlier test-6 integration run rejected a stale action before its successful reruns.
timing_worker_change: RC_VERSION display string only; timer/storage/control logic unchanged.

functional_baseline.maintainer_report: Five consecutive successful launches alternating Restart and complete Shutdown/reboot on PS5 13.60.

resident_baseline_comparison.explanation: Only debugger metadata containing the build directory differs; executable code and allocated data match.

maintainer_console_report.evidence: Maintainer report; no new runtime logs supplied.
